record_title: Renormalized top-hat asymptotics for finite step packets in scale-invariant 2D Euler
provenance: A source-specific asymptotic refinement of arXiv:2609.20674v1. Finite positive step packets admit an exact outer-edge coefficient and an L1 renormalized top-hat limit; in the one-step problem the inner edge is quadratically slaved to the outer edge and the first geometric correction to 1/b is logarithmic.
limitations: The top-hat theorem concerns finite positive step data in the m>=4 reduced sector. It does not cover the infinite stacks used in the dense-orbit construction, arbitrary L-infinity or sign-changing data, or the m=3 regime. The subleading logarithmic expansion is proved only for a single interval.
